historical_record.description: The R-3.5 property held a three-unit apartment building, one unit of which was used without authorization as the office of the Sickle Cell Anemia Disease Research Foundation.

The Sickle Cell Anemia Disease Research Foundation, a charitable institution, occupied space in the building, paying $150 a month rent, in an R-3.5 district. The City Planning Commission unanimously approved, with four conditions, a conditional use letting the Sickle Cell Anemia Disease Research Foundation use part of the existing building as its office (Resolution 7108), after no affordable space was found on Haight Street.
